title: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Theme 11: Haki za kibinadamu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child forms kutendana (-ana), kutendeana (-eana/-iana) and kutendesha (-esha/-isha, or the special form) by meaning.
steps: Each other, for each other, or cause?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kuheshimiana" and one causative.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendana?" Kwa nini "somesha" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendesha?" Kwa nini "pigana" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendeana?" Kwa nini "somesha" si jibu sahihi?
Kamusi inaonyesha kutendesha kwa kitenzi hiki?
misconceptions.repair: Baadhi ya vitenzi vina kutendesha maalum: lala -> laza.
